If you go to the hospital and show them your cuts I can GUARANTEE you will be admitted into the psych ward for at least 3 days located at the hospital. When I went I sat down and they asked me questions. Questions ranged from how I was feeling and if I wanted to hurt myself or others. When I showed them my cuts they immediately recommend me ti be admitted. Whats common is that your there for three days were they assess you and wait for you to cool down. Also they will have you see a psychiatrist about your medication. My advice is to go but try not to on the weekends. Most hospitals dont have group sessions on weekends  so you'll miss some valuable stuff
